instruction: A candid medium shot photograph set in an indoor office with a wooden bookshelf in the background. On the left, the bearded man in the grey polo (R2) stands in profile facing right, holding a manila folder in his left hand and smiling. On the right, the woman with glasses (R1) stands facing left, holding a folder in her left hand and smiling back. They extend their right arms to shake hands in the center of the frame. The scene is illuminated by warm indoor lighting, casting soft shadows on the cream-colored walls.
